graphEvents.label: Advisor scoring rules behave as released

label: [drift, P2] v4.0.0.15 promises a confidence-floored skill counts as tied only when its score is also close, but ambiguity.ts applies the floor exception only when the top is not itself floored (top.confidenceFloored !== true); with a floored top, every floored skill ties at confidence 0.82 regardless of score. Observed on 'do not write anything, just explain how the advisor scores a prompt': ambiguous=true with top 0.535201 vs third 0.150083 (gap 0.385).

[bug, P2] readOnlyRouteAllowed matches 'do not (change|edit|modify|touch)' but not 'write', so a prompt whose only read-only marker is 'do not write anything' is scored as write-capable and system-spec-kit stays in the candidate set at 0.150083 while the top is sk-prompt. Introduced: UNKNOWN; present at v4.0.0.16.

[operator UX, P2] The workflow-first rule keeps system-deep-loop at rank 1 (score 0.642453) above cli-external-orchestration (score 0.737707) for 'use cli-pi for deep research on the relaunch hooks', but the serialized recommendation carries no rank-override marker, so a consumer that sorts or displays by score inverts the documented order.

[improvement, P2] 'review .skilled/skills/sk-doc/SKILL.md for outdated guidance' routes to sk-code review (0.753218) and puts sk-doc second (0.333278) with compiledRoute.action='defer' and zero targets, so the doc skill cannot be executed from the recommendation even when selected; the path-suppression rule itself behaves as v4.0.0.7 promises.
A confidence-floored skill ties the top only when its score is within the 0.05 ambiguity margin (v4.0.0.15 promise).
